msItem.title: Tigre poems (fidal)
msItem.note: Tigre poems, written in Ethiopian characters and with titles in Italian. The text is written on the left column. The columns on the right side of the page, which have been probably intended for a translation, are blank. Most of the authors of the poems are the same as in . Apart from the variation in orthography and redaction, the larger part of the poems can be found in .

msItem.title: Song of Hachin, son of Medin
msItem.incipit: Canzone di Hachin figlio di Medin

ውላድ፡ ስንሒት፡ ጨበሊት፡ አይተአሙሮ፡ ብካዩ።
በክዮማ፡ አላቡ፡ አና፡ ጀንጀርቱ፡ ባክያዩ፡
ካብር፡ አድናቱ፡ አብ፡ ዳልካ፡ እት፡ መናብር፡ ግሳዩ፡
